name: Cajun Butter Steak Bites

fit.note: 492 cal inside 400-650; 4 g carbs well under the 35 g ceiling; sirloin cubes batch-scale to 14; no seafood. Fit is fine - killed on duplication, not fitness.

dupe_check.accepted_slugs_pool: Same dish as the already-accepted garlic-butter-steak-bites-zucchini. Three-plus of four axes match: protein = sirloin cut into 2-inch cubes (same), method = pan-seared in a garlic-butter fond (same), core plate = butter-seared steak bites with no starch (same). The only real difference is a Cajun spice rub (paprika/cayenne/thyme/oregano/chili) swapped for the garlic-butter seasoning, plus dropping the zucchini side - a seasoning reskin of the same dinner, not a new plate. The catalog already carries TWO steak-bite entries in this family (garlic-butter-steak-bites-zucchini and honey-garlic-steak-bites-potatoes); a third butter-steak-bites reskin would embarrass the catalog. Sourcer honestly self-flagged this risk.
dupe_check.catalog_digest: Confirms the crowding: honey-garlic-steak-bites-potatoes is the live steak-bites cousin; nothing else in the digest is a butter-seared steak-cube dish, but the accepted garlic-butter version is the direct twin.

cross_protein_flag: Cajun butter + seared cubes structure could recur as a chicken or pork 'Cajun butter bites' candidate; if the garlic-butter keeper ever falls out, a Cajun steak-bites slot could be reconsidered, but as things stand it loses to the accepted garlic-butter twin. Note the Cajun/Creole cuisine tag would have widened the American-skewed catalog - a point for the decider only if it wants to trade the garlic-butter version out, not a reason to ship both.
